services.name: Horse Care Team
services.desc: Horses and Friends Part 1 is an introduction to horses that offers children a unique opportunity to connect with horses through observation and hands-on grooming. This session focuses on building trust, learning about horse characteristics, and understanding their body language. Children will gain a deeper appreciation for the gentle nature of horses while developing important emotional and social skills in a safe, supportive environment. Horses and Friends Part 2 invites students to deepen their bond of trust and respect with their horse. In this engaging program, students will practice connective grooming learn how to halter their horse, and develop essential leading skills. Confidence
